name: 85-nanabolele
description: Nanabolele: a Sotho river dragon from flooded caves, dark green scaly body, horned dragon head, pale belly, glowing pale green scale lights along its back and tail tip. Flat black-outline pixel art.

idle.action: Lying low in place: the glowing scale lights along its back pulse brighter from tail to head, then it gapes its fanged jaws wide, every light blazing, then closes them. Feet planted, same facing, same size. Black one-pixel outlines, flat fills.
